about: Documented schema differences between the sdk-ts and sdk-rs identity outcome exports: fields one SDK reports and the other does not, each with the corpus, case (glob or list), step (absent: the case itself; "*": any step; a number), field (dotted glob: * inside a key is any characters, a ** key any number of keys), the side that reports it, and why. Anything else one side lacks is a divergence (scripts/identity-differential.mjs); an entry that covers nothing is stale.

differences.why: IDENTITY-PROFILE-01 §4 rule 2: a field (or a roster/devices entry) with concurrent values is reported by sdk-ts as `<key>_conflict_set`, every concurrent value (the convention of the corpus's own entry inputs), and by sdk-rs as one of them; a reader MAY show any value of these display fields. Same merged document, two views (spec question 6).
